Again, thanks for all the help. It's been very helpful. I got the brew
working but I have some other questions. when I create test.brew file
with this:

<%
x<-1:10000
print(x)
%>

and, I call test.brew via the browser it works. I get numbers from 1
throught 10000. If I wanted to plot this and show the plot in the
browser, I do this:

<%
x<-1:10000
t=plot(x)
print(t)
%>

This does not work, I dont see anything in the browser. Can someone
please and example of plot that works with brew?
